answer: Make every agent earn inside a grove of strangers: each epoch the network pairs each identity with a random peer to audit its work, and pay flows only when the audit passes. A zephyr of verdicts drifts peer to peer, so a clone's fake work is exposed by auditors it cannot choose. Clones auditing clones form a closed loop, but random pairing forces each clone to face strangers across a canyon it cannot bridge with copies, so the Nth clone costs as much real work as the first.
